district_scope: All districts of the selected states
symptoms: Older lower leaves develop dark target-like concentric spots; yellowing and defoliation; dark sunken stem or fruit lesions
damage: Defoliation, sunscald, reduced fruit size and yield, poor marketability
immediate_action: Scout regularly; remove severely infected lower leaves; avoid overhead irrigation; stake plants
eco_friendly_prevention: Use treated/clean seed; maintain spacing; mulch to reduce soil splash; use Trichoderma where officially supported

district_scope: All districts of the selected states
symptoms: Water-soaked irregular green-brown lesions; white downy growth under humid conditions; brown dry rot patches on tubers
damage: Rapid foliage destruction, field/storage tuber rot, possible total crop failure
immediate_action: Monitor cool humid weather; stop overhead irrigation; remove blighted foliage before harvest
eco_friendly_prevention: Use certified seed; resistant/tolerant cultivars; earthing-up; Trichoderma seed treatment only when officially supported
